name: PT Wahana Inti Makmur Tbk
summary: PT Wahana Inti Makmur Tbk, an Indonesian enterprise, manufactures and distributes a diverse range of rice products across the country. Its offerings encompass aromatic, healthy, tarabas, medium grain, premium grade, and basmati rice, alongside various private-labeled rice options. The company was established in 2015 and is based in Tangerang, Indonesia.
